quotes.author: Jared
quotes.text: I have been out of the US before on similar vacations, but my experience of EF was incredible, and our tour guide, Gigi, absolutely made the trip what it was. My wife and I always felt safe and like we knew where to go after he explained how to get around each city, had plenty of time to roam and do our own thing, while Gigi planned great extra group meals and activities throughout. He was great at bringing the group together to foster authentic connections between the travelers, which made seeing the incredible sights of Italy even better. Stopping off in Orvieto and Pompeii were highlights as well, and really made it feel like we got a grand tour of Italy. Can’t wait to book our next one!

quotes.author: Anonymous
quotes.text: France: Castles, Coasts, and Croissants was an amazing experience and I would absolutely recommend it! There was a great mix of planned activities and free time, but I’d recommend planning any big excursions ahead of time so you can make the most of your time (especially in Paris.) Definitely bring a good pair of walking shoes, I averaged around 22,000 steps a day. My favorite part by far was St. Malo, and I especially loved getting to see so much of the WWII history throughout the small towns. Magda was a FANTASTIC tour director and truly made the trip more fun and enjoyable. She makes everyone feel like family. Overall, an incredible trip that I’ll never forget! CANNONBALL!! 😉

quotes.author: Billy
quotes.text: We went to Italy, Austria, Germany, and Switzerland (with a pit stop in Liechtenstein). If you like trips that are go go go, this is the one to do. I loved it, it allowed us to see so much in the 9 days of this tour. Lots of great excursions to do, but if you decide not to do them, you’ll have some free time which is nice! Our tour director Marco made the trip even better, as he was informative and an amazing time. Great time, great vibes, and lots to see, so you have to remember to take it all in as it goes on. If you want to hit multiple countries in one go, this is the perfect trip to do so. I highly recommend this trip!

quotes.author: Sarah
quotes.text: Getting to spend nearly two weeks bopping around Croatia was the highlight of my summer! Swimming in gorgeous blue water in the morning and then exploring a new city for the afternoon was absolutely wonderful! This was my first group trip and I will absolutely take more in the future! I came with one friend but walked away with so many new friends and shared memories with others on the trip!! I would definitely recommend cruising around Croatia as your Euro summer trip!

quotes.author: Rebecca
quotes.text: Just came back from the best trip of my life! if you have any hesitations about this trip, don't!! Everything from the food, to the hotels to the guides were nothing short of amazing! Ken was the best as our TD and I was lucky enough to have him as my jeep guide as well. He was so knowledgeable and we were lucky enough to see the Big 5. I will never stop talking about this trip and wish I could live it again for the first time.

quotes.author: Odianne
quotes.text: This trip was amazing. All the tours and sights were well thought out, exciting yet very informative. Dario, our tour director, was phenomenal and made the experience even better by bringing all positive energy and tons of fun. Long travel days were better because of him. Be prepared for lots of walking but it makes for great stories...and side quests. I loved every minute of it. Highly recommend.
